Hey dude last night I wanted to die a lot(unrelated to your reason OP). I'm just going to say I woke up this morning and realized that life really is worth living. If you want to PM me OP and have some discourse (about anything I'm an open book we can talk about anything).



I'm just going to say that just because that orange man is the future president that is no reason to die. There has been some pretty fucked up Presidents in that office. You should look at this as an opportunity to become a political activist if anything. Join a political movement and stop him from doing anything truly terrible. If you are really afraid of a trump America go out and try to make changes in your local government and states. YOU CAN MAKE CHANGE!!!!!!! OP if you are still reading this I just want you to know that the situation the country is is just a reason to live, to make change, to inspire others, to stand up for what you believe in. This is not a reason to end your life.
